name: Landsat
manufacturer: Ball Aerospace / Lockheed Martin (varied by generation)
best_known_for: Longest continuous Earth-imaging record in history — Landsat 1 through 9 spanning 50+ years; 30 m resolution multispectral imaging in sun-synchronous orbit at 705 km
credit: NASA + USGS Landsat programme. Started 1972 as ERTS-1; current operational satellites Landsat 8 (2013) + Landsat 9 (2021). Free public data archive since 2008.
